title: ULA approximate beamwidth
prompt: Implement `half_power_beamwidth_deg(n, d_over_lambda)` approximate broadside HPBW in degrees: 0.886 * (lambda/(N*d)) in radians converted to degrees (use math). `d_over_lambda` is d/λ.
public_tests_hint:
- larger N → narrower beam
- matches formula within 1e-9
test_source:
import math
import solution

def run():
    bw=solution.half_power_beamwidth_deg(10,0.5)
    expect=math.degrees(0.886/(10*0.5))
    assert abs(bw-expect)<1e-9
    assert solution.half_power_beamwidth_deg(20,0.5)<bw
